rows.note: The bounded record connects executive enforcement policy, targeting and prioritization requirements, case-management and analytics deployment, and material public funding.
rows.ceil: bounded policy and system inference authority
rows.next: Acquire deidentified person-level traces joining source data, identity, priority, human decision, consequence, and review.
rows.fals: The systems did not materially inform any consequential investigative or enforcement action.

rows.note: Public records describe capabilities and mission, not the encoded categories, weights, confidence rules, mandatory-use rules, or version history.
rows.next: Acquire data dictionaries, rules, model cards, user stories, feature traceability, policy directives, thresholds, changes, and legal review.
rows.fals: The delivered system contains no material prioritization or threshold function.

rows.note: The current record lacks a complete case chain and therefore cannot adjudicate the practical burden or remedy.
rows.next: Acquire notices, case files, logs, officer and supervisor decisions, stays, corrections, appeals, outcomes, costs, and explicit non-links.
rows.fals: Complete samples show the system supplied no material inference or the institution bore and satisfied a strong ex ante burden.

rows.note: The source set establishes system design and operation but no chronological subject-level file.
rows.next: Acquire timestamped case chronology from source collection through final disposition, including any pre-action notice or stay.
rows.fals: Representative cases show notice, inspection, and effective stay before material consequence.

rows.note: Congressional oversight requested databases, contractors, sources, legal authorities, safeguards, accuracy controls, sharing, and operational uses, demonstrating that the complete archive was not already public.
rows.next: Acquire the source-to-target field lineage, interface inventory, log custody, retention, discovery, audit, and disclosure matrix.
rows.fals: ICE independently holds and discloses a complete, accurate, versioned, and auditable chain.

rows.note: Forty-two vendors and transition estimates show an evaluated market, not a tested substitute under equivalent load.
rows.next: Acquire vendor denominator, requirements, demonstrations, exclusions, transition pilots, interoperability, data exports, and performance comparisons.
rows.fals: A viable alternative operated under comparable conditions and was rejected despite superior outcomes.

rows.note: Human officers and supervisors exist in the workflow, but exception authority and recorded use are not source-bounded.
rows.next: Acquire role permissions, override reasons, supervisor approvals, emergency exceptions, mandatory-use directives, and audits.
rows.fals: No material exception power exists or every use is independently reviewable and disclosed.

rows.note: The USAspending record anchors public resource flow, while the current estate lacks award economics and consequence-level error allocation.
rows.ceil: public funding and private benefit without person-level causal join
rows.next: Acquire invoices, costs, revenue recognition, performance, error samples, correction costs, remedies, and ownership chronology.
rows.fals: Complete records show no asymmetric error burden or disproportionate residual benefit tied to the system.
